thu-word-on-the-water.title: Walk to Word on the Water
thu-word-on-the-water.lead: Once you are clear of Eurostar arrivals, head out to Pancras Road and along to the canal.

calendar.note: Pancras Road exit · then about 8–10 minutes on foot to the canal bookshop.

thu-to-blackheath.title: Back to St Pancras for the train to Blackheath
thu-to-blackheath.lead: Walk back to the St Pancras main entrance, cross The Circle to Thameslink A/B, change at London Bridge, then walk to the hotel.

calendar.note: Enter by the main entrance from Pancras Road, walk straight across The Circle and follow Thameslink A/B signs down. Planned trains: 17:55 Thameslink to London Bridge, 18:22 Southeastern to Blackheath.

fri-to-charing-cross.title: Hotel to Charing Cross
fri-to-charing-cross.lead: Walk to Blackheath station, pick up coffee at Tiny Brew in the booking hall, and take the 08:51 to Charing Cross.

calendar.note: Tiny Brew is inside the booking hall. 08:51 Southeastern to Charing Cross from platform 1 (towards London).
Leave Charing Cross by the Strand exit, then up Southampton Street and through Covent Garden.

steps.title: Leave by the Strand exit
steps.text: Follow the Way out / Strand signs across the main concourse.

steps.title: Up Southampton Street to Covent Garden
steps.text: Through the piazza, then on to Stanfords on Mercer Walk.

steps.title: Through Covent Garden’s side streets
steps.text: Then along St Giles Passage to Charing Cross Road.

sat-greenwich-park.title: Across the heath to the Observatory hill
sat-greenwich-park.lead: An easy walk across Blackheath, into Greenwich Park by Blackheath Gate, and up to the hilltop view. The free meridian marker is outside the ticketed Observatory courtyard.

calendar.note: Enter Greenwich Park by Blackheath Gate, then walk to the Observatory hill viewpoint.

sat-to-market.title: Down to Greenwich Market
sat-to-market.lead: Lunch from the street-food stalls and a browse. If there is spare time before the cruise, the free sights nearby are marked on the map.

sat-to-pier.title: Walk to Greenwich Pier for the cruise
sat-to-pier.lead: Aim to reach the pier around 14:10. Boarding starts at 14:20 for the 14:30 City Cruises departure; follow the ticket and staff directions on the pontoon.

calendar.note: Boarding from 14:20 for the 14:30 City Cruises sightseeing departure.

sections.title: Thames cruise · 14:30 to about 17:30
sections.text: Greenwich → Westminster → Greenwich, about three hours round trip. Back in Greenwich around 17:30.

sun-to-eurostar.title: Hotel to St Pancras for the Eurostar
sun-to-eurostar.lead: First train from Blackheath to Victoria, then the Victoria line to King’s Cross St Pancras. Aim to reach Eurostar Departures around 07:45 for the 09:01 train.

calendar.note: 06:59 Southeastern to Victoria from platform 1. At Victoria follow Underground signs to the Victoria line northbound (towards Walthamstow Central) to King’s Cross St Pancras, then follow Eurostar signs along the Arcade to Departures.

sections.title: Planned trains

services.detail: Platform 1, towards London · first train of the morning
Northbound, towards Walthamstow Central · trains every few minutes

sections.fallback: If the 06:59 is missed, the next planned train is 07:29, arriving at Victoria 07:55.

steps.title: Follow St Pancras International / Eurostar signs

steps.title: Come up into the Arcade

sat-thames-cruise.title: Thames cruise
notes: Departs 14:30, boarding from 14:20. Greenwich → Westminster → Greenwich, about three hours; back around 17:30.
Booked: 2 × Return Adult. The ticket QR code is under Tickets (locked) above, and in the City Experiences app.
On arrival, walk straight down onto the pier; pier staff will direct you to the boarding point.
Boats leave on time and can’t wait for late arrivals. Some circular tours need a boat change at Tower Pier.
sat-thames-cruise.reminder: Ask the skipper whether we need to get off and board another boat for the return trip.

stp_arrivals.title: St Pancras · arrivals to Pancras Road
stp_arrivals.subtitle: Ground floor
stp_arrivals.text: Follow Eurostar Arrivals out into the station, then the Pancras Road exit signs.

stp_thameslink.title: St Pancras · to Thameslink
stp_thameslink.subtitle: Main entrance from Pancras Road · Floor 0
stp_thameslink.text: Walk straight across The Circle. Look for Thameslink A/B signs and take the escalators down. Check the screen for a train calling at London Bridge.
stp_thameslink.credit: St Pancras Living Map · station operator

london_bridge.title: London Bridge · change trains
london_bridge.subtitle: Stay inside the station · lower concourse
london_bridge.text: From Thameslink platforms 4/5, follow signs down to the lower concourse. Look for the information point beside platforms 6/7, check the screens for the Blackheath train, then follow its platform signs.

blackheath_arrival.title: Blackheath · exit to the village
blackheath_arrival.subtitle: Use the booking hall exit
blackheath_arrival.text: Trains from London normally arrive on platform 2. Follow the ramp to the booking hall and out to the village; The Clarendon is about 350 m away.

blackheath_departure.title: Blackheath · trains to London
blackheath_departure.subtitle: Booking hall · platform 1
blackheath_departure.text: Enter through the booking hall facing the village. Trains towards London leave from platform 1; follow the platform signs and check the screen.

charing_cross_arrival.title: Charing Cross · out to the Strand
charing_cross_arrival.subtitle: Main concourse
charing_cross_arrival.text: From the platforms, cross the main concourse and follow Way out · Strand. Station exit numbers are not the same as the Underground’s exit numbers.

charing_cross_departure.title: Charing Cross · to the trains
charing_cross_departure.subtitle: Enter from the Strand
charing_cross_departure.text: Enter from the Strand and cross to the main concourse. Check the boards for a Southeastern train to Blackheath, or one to Lewisham with a change there.

victoria_to_tube.title: Victoria · to the Victoria line
victoria_to_tube.subtitle: Southeastern side → front concourse Underground
victoria_to_tube.text: Southeastern trains use platforms 1–8. Follow Underground signs across the front concourse and go down to the Tube. Take the Victoria line northbound, towards Walthamstow Central. Lifts are by the Eastern Archway visitor centre.

stp_departures.title: St Pancras · Eurostar Departures
stp_departures.subtitle: The Arcade · Floor 0
stp_departures.text: Along the ground-floor Arcade, follow Eurostar Departures to the ticket gates. Platforms are beyond security and passport control.
stp_departures.credit: St Pancras Living Map · station operator
